notes.title: Unforgiving Happiness Update 1.01
notes.notes:
○Added music volume control
○Enabled HDR
○Enabled the ability to map your keys
○Fix some bugs
○The game can now run in the background
○You can now choose window/fullscreen mode

notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.notes:
Addded 40+ Achievements.
    Each level now has two puzzles, one for the achievement and another for 
       the main puzzle.
    Increased the door opening speed.
    Improved visuals.
    Fixed some bugs.
    Improved lighting on some levels.
